test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the term for a famous person's signature on a piece of paper or item?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Autograph**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Autograph"** refers to a signature, especially that of a famous person, written as a memento for a fan or admirer. (हस्ताक्षर, विशेष रूप से किसी प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति का) • **Example:** The fans waited for hours to get the celebrity's autograph on their books. • A **"Signature"** is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or agreement. (हस्ताक्षर, किसी दस्तावेज़ को प्रमाणित करने के लिए) • **Example:** Please provide your signature at the bottom of the form. • However, the term "Autograph" is specifically used when referring to a famous person's signature as a keepsake. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Autograph**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Signature** (हस्ताक्षर): A person's written name to signify authorization. • **Example:** The document is invalid without your signature. • **Initial** (आरंभिक अक्षर): The first letter of someone's name, typically used as an abbreviation. • **Example:** Please write your initials next to the corrections you made. • **Emblem** (प्रतीक): A symbolic design or representation. • **Example:** The national emblem is a symbol of the country's pride and culture. 4b:T97c, The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Biography**.
